tasks.title: Add browser/e2e tests for the ImageAsciiConverter UI, export, and share round-trip
tasks.description: The entire ~1400-line ImageAsciiConverter class in src/script.js (upload, render, color-mode fallback, PNG/HTML/TXT export, and the #s= share encode/decode round-trip) has zero automated coverage; only the pure functions in src/ascii-core.js, settings-schema.js, and share-codec.js are unit-tested. docs/STATUS-TRACKER.md flags this as open item D1 and 'the largest residual risk.' Add a Playwright (or jsdom-based) smoke layer covering upload->render, each color mode, the color-budget grayscale fallback, the export buttons, and an enterViewMode(shareValue) round-trip under the production CSP from vercel.json.

tasks.title: Width/height range sliders cap at max=1000 but the app supports MAX_DIMENSION=2000
tasks.description: In src/script.js:261 and :265 the width/height range inputs are hardcoded max="1000", while clampDimension/MAX_DIMENSION allow up to 2000 and updateSliderMax only runs once an image is loaded. On restore, applySettings (script.js:702-706) assigns a persisted dimension >1000 to slider.value (browser silently clamps the thumb to 1000) while the sibling width-value/height-value textContent shows the true 2000 — a visible value/label desync until an image loads. Set the markup max to MAX_DIMENSION (or run updateSliderMax-style clamping in applySettings before an image exists).

tasks.title: Image upload validates MIME only, accepting SVG/zero-intrinsic-size images that fail conversion after a success toast
tasks.description: handleFileSelect in src/script.js:758 gates uploads with file.type.startsWith('image/'), which admits image/svg+xml and other formats lacking intrinsic dimensions. An SVG with no width/height decodes with naturalWidth/naturalHeight of 0 (or a 300x150 default), so the preview onload still fires 'Image loaded successfully!' (script.js:837) and then processImage's drawImage with a 0x0 source rect throws, surfacing a contradictory 'Error:' in the output. Guard on previewImg.naturalWidth > 0 && naturalHeight > 0 (and consider rejecting SVG explicitly) before declaring success.

tasks.title: PNG color export advances by a single 'M' width, overflowing non-monospace (emoji) custom charsets
tasks.description: exportAsPng in src/script.js:1284-1310 measures one monoCharWidth = measureText('M') and advances every colored cell by it, while the canvas width is sized from measureText(line) (script.js:1252). For a custom emoji charset (wider-than-'M' glyphs, allowed via the 'custom' charsetType) the per-cell background rects and glyphs overlap and the right edge can clip, so the exported PNG no longer matches the on-screen color render. Measure per-cell advance, or size monoCharWidth from the actual rendered glyph rather than assuming monospace.

tasks.title: customCharset .slice(0, 200) can split a surrogate pair, leaving a lone-surrogate glyph
tasks.description: Both the live input handler (src/script.js:619) and sanitizeSettings (src/settings-schema.js:61) cap the custom charset with String#slice(0, 200), which counts UTF-16 code units. A 200-code-unit charset ending mid-emoji is truncated to a lone high surrogate; prepareGlyphs' Array.from then yields a broken half-codepoint glyph in the ramp — the same class of bug the hub-177 grapheme work elsewhere fixed. Cap by code point (e.g. Array.from(str).slice(0, 200).join('')) so the boundary never bisects a surrogate pair.

tasks.title: On reload with resolution=Custom + aspect lock, only height is recomputed for the new image, not width
tasks.description: In handleFileSelect's custom-mode branch (src/script.js:826-833) a newly loaded image recomputes settings.height from the existing settings.width but never re-derives or re-validates width against the new image. updateSliderMax (called just before, script.js:813) may have lowered the width slider's max below the carried-over settings.width, so the slider thumb clamps to the new max while settings.width and the width-value label retain the larger stale number — a width/label/setting desync. Re-clamp settings.width to the new slider max and update both width-slider.value and width-value in this branch.

tasks.title: Refactor the monolithic 1400-line ImageAsciiConverter into focused modules
tasks.description: src/script.js is a single ~1400-line class mixing UI setup/listeners, image processing, three export paths, and sharing — flagged in FUTURE-IMPROVEMENTS.md. Splitting into UIManager (setupUI/applySettings/listeners), ImageProcessor (processImage/pixelsToAscii), ExportManager (exportAsTxt/Png/Html/downloadBlob), and ShareManager (shareAscii) would make the currently untested UI layer (see the e2e task) far easier to unit-test and reason about, since the pure-core extraction pattern in ascii-core.js already demonstrates the approach.

summary: Found 7 issues: 4 UI-boundary correctness/robustness bugs (slider max vs MAX_DIMENSION value/label desync, MIME-only upload accepting unconvertible SVG/zero-size images, PNG color export overflow for non-monospace emoji charsets, surrogate-pair split in the 200-char customCharset cap, plus a custom-resolution reload width desync), and 2 quality/maintainability items (no browser/e2e tests for the UI/export/share layer, and the monolithic 1400-line converter class). No high-severity security or data-loss issues found — the prior hardening (CSP, HTML escaping, dimension clamps, share sanitization, file-size limits, race tokens) is genuinely in place per docs/STATUS-TRACKER.md.
